reasoning: On the season so far the Rockets are the stronger team; with home court the Rockets start about 19 points better, in a game of about 223 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Rockets win 94 times in 100, by about 18; most games like this end between 197 and 245 total points.

analyst.text: Utah are 1-11 and badly short-handed, with Lauri Markkanen (hand fractures) and Jaren Jackson Jr. (MCL) out for weeks. Will Hardy says the late-game collapses are no coincidence. Houston beat Golden State, but Marcus Smart was ejected for a punch and could face discipline, a possible distraction. Rookie Darryn Peterson's run of four straight 20-point games gives Utah something to play for. The mood still leans heavily toward Houston.
